name: Alphalete - Domain Authority Roadmap 2026-07-18
body:
> Plan · Alphalete · 2026-07-18

# Summary
A step-by-step "do it little by little" authority plan prepared for Kim (Jul 18 2026). Starting point: Authority Score 2, 20 referring domains, 0 organic traffic. Each task is tagged Kim, Claude, or Together.

# Phases
- **Phase 0, Foundation (first):** confirm the sitemap is read in GSC; finish unique rewrites of priority city pages; make sure rewritten pages are indexable (no leftover OTTO/MetaSync noindex); request indexing; confirm Service and FAQ schema; check speed. Links do little until pages are indexed and trusted.
- **Phase 1, Citations and NAP:** identical NAP everywhere using the base number, never tracking numbers (the file names (720) 807-3224, but the official number is still undecided per later files). Core listings: GBP, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Houzz, BBB, Nextdoor; niche directories, data aggregators, Colorado directories; audit and fix inconsistent listings.
- **Phase 2, Local partnerships and supplier links:** trade associations (NASSCO, plumbing groups), Chamber of Commerce, supplier "find a contractor" pages, referral partners (agents, inspectors, property managers, restoration).
- **Phase 3, Reviews and brand signals:** a review-request system, reply to every review, steady flow, consistent info.
- **Phase 4, Digital PR:** a linkable asset (for example a Denver metro sewer repair cost guide or aging infrastructure data), pitch list, journalist-request platforms, one asset per quarter.

# What not to do
No cheap link packages, PBNs or "DA booster" gigs; no links to thin city pages before rewrites; no blanket phone replacement; treat traffic and leads as the goal, not the score.

# Status
- Citations and listings are on hold until there is one official NAP phone and a GBP brand-name decision (Oct 1 handoff). GBP is with the Agency owner.
- The Jul 22 baseline found the existing 20 referring domains were all spam (see [Alphalete - SEO Baseline 2026-07-22](lib:brain-alphalete-seo-baseline-2026-07-22)). By Oct 13 GSC showed 4 external links (per [Alphalete - Performance Evidence 2026-10-13](lib:brain-alphalete-performance-evidence-2026-10-13) file names).
- No paid tools or services without approval (see [Alphalete - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-alphalete-decisions-and-rules)).
